scope: League exposure presentation after the corrected active Zebre October and November build is released.

reporting_contract.season_hours: Sum all sixteen final active team releases; Benetton and Edinburgh retain explicitly labelled temporary season estimates.
reporting_contract.season_distance: Sum only final active team releases with a non-null source-backed distance value.
reporting_contract.monthly_values: Report a monthly hours or distance sum when one or more source-backed teams contribute, with its contributor count.
reporting_contract.monthly_rates: Null unless all sixteen teams contribute a positive monthly exposure denominator.
reporting_contract.missing_june: No zero is inferred for a team or league month without a reported value.

activation_prerequisites: The active Zebre build contains included corrected October and November exposure rows.
Approved final active team releases exist for Zebre, Benetton and Edinburgh.
All sixteen active team releases remain bound to their active curated builds.
exclusions: This rule does not fabricate source exposure, monthly exposure, distance, fixtures or injury data.
This rule does not alter the frozen 2024-25 season.
